reuse.why: The actions reuse budget, batching and undo helpers, but introduce parallel notes storage and custom tag matching instead of using the existing notes store and shared tag utilities.

duplication.why: Four actions repeat category-selection SQL, independently enforce the helper's template exclusion, and retain repeated income eligibility checks.

placement.why: Budget policy belongs in actions.ts, but adding category and group notes columns bypasses the established notes module and persistence model.

scope.why: Most edits support the requested actions, but introducing category notes storage and changing a historical migration unnecessarily broadens the change.

maintainability.why: The shared exclusion predicate helps, but parallel notes storage and eligibility rules split between SQL and caller branches leave multiple definitions to maintain.

bypasses_abstraction.where: The new notes columns bypass server/notes/app.ts and the notes table, while shouldSkipBulkBudget implements tag recognition instead of using shared/tags.ts.

disguised_duplication.where: setLastMonthSpending, set3MonthAvg, set6MonthAvg and set12MonthAvg express the helper's goal_def exclusion again as SQL predicates, disguising duplicated policy as data selection.

abstraction_drift.where: shouldSkipBulkBudget gains includeHiddenCategories and its conditional hidden-rule override; four action queries independently apply goal_def IS NULL before invoking the helper.
